messages:
anya: Heads-up — EdgeCore (ops) confirmed they can run a joint perf/W + throughput + kernel-tune sprint next Tue-Thu. We need to lock the test matrix, who owns kernel patches, and telemetry hooks.

kevin: sweet. main priorities?

mira: perf/W curves, sustained throughput at 95th pct, and kernel latency tail. also quantized vs fp16 comparisons.

sam: recommend a 3x3 matrix: seq_len {512,1024,2048} x batch {1,4,8} + separate perf/W runs with steady-state long-run (30min) for thermals.

edgecore_ops: thanks — we can provision 8 nodes (A100-ish equivalent) and attach power meters. need your exact run script and kernel build.

anya: @edgecore_ops great. can you confirm vendor fw and OS? we need kernel 5.10+ and nv driver 525+. also want a dmesg+perf snapshots every 5m.

edgecore_ops: OS: ubuntu-22.04, kernel-5.15 (we can drop to 5.10 if you require). nvidia 525.85. we have rack-level PDUs for power draw.

kevin: we'll target kernel-5.15 but test 5.10 diff for regressions. who will land kernel opts? @mira / @sam?

mira: I'll own the kernel-side changes (minimal tunables: C-states, irq affinity, rcu tweaks, scheduler tunables). sam can own the bench harness and postproc.

sam: yep. I'll push the run harness to the partnership repo and include a smoke script. asking for a small config format — propose JSON like:

```json
{
  "model": "llama-parameters-variant",
  "seq": 1024,
  "batch": 4,
  "dtype": "fp16",
  "duration_min": 30
}
```

mira: looks good. add a field for "kernel_profile" and "power_sample_rate_s".

anya: we'll need telemetry tags so metrics ingest into our console: add labels {partner:edgecore, site:lab-alpha, run_id:UUID}.

bench-bot: Reminder: Please upload perf traces to s3://redwood-partnerships/edgecore/bench-2412345678 within 24h of run completion. :bell:

edgecore_ops: ack. will mount an S3 gateway. can you provide the AWS creds and the exact s3 path layout?

kevin: creds via secrets manager — I'll create an expiring role. path layout: /edgecore/{date}/{run_id}/{node}/metrics.tar.gz. please include raw power logs and perf.data.

anya: quick decision: do we run synthetic-only (streaming token generator) or service-level (our real end-to-end API) for throughput?

mira: do both. synthetic to isolate kernel/hw, then 1 E2E run to validate real tail-latency. schedule synthetic first.

sam: timeline proposal: Mon prep + kernel builds, Tue-Thu runs, Fri quick analysis and 1-page summary. can team commit to that?

edgecore_ops: Tue-Thu works for us. we'll reserve machines and power meters.

kevin: I'll create the run checklist and assign PRs. can someone volunteer to prepare the 1-pg summary template?

anya: I'll draft the template based on previous bench summaries and share by EOD today.

mira: I'll attach the kernel patch list and tuning notes to the PR.

sam: prepping harness now. ping me in #eng-runtime if you need the smoke run.

anya: perfect — next actions: kevin creates GH issue + checklist, mira lands kernel branch, sam pushes harness, edgecore_ops confirms nodes + fw, bench-bot will remind on Tue morning. :thumbsup:

kevin: filing issue now — link will be in this thread.

edgecore_ops: thanks all — looking forward to the handoff.

anya: thanks team. short sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize matrix.
